newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Lenenergo holds ordinary dividend at three rbls.
newsitem.headline: Lenenergo holds ordinary dividend at three rbls.

text.p: NOTE - Full name AOOT Lenenergo LSNG.RTS LSNG_p.RTS. Shareholders elected Anatoly Dyakov as chairman of the board of directors. Dyakov is already chairman of Unified Energy System (UES) EESR.RTS, Lenenergo's biggest shareholder.

These figures are not prepared to international accounting standards but to Russian accounting standards, which differ significantly from those normally supplied in the West. Russian accounts are designed to meet the requirements of the tax authorities. Russian companies can choose whether to show revenues and spending on a cash or accruals basis. These figures are on an accruals basis. Definitions of profit and assets differ significantly from those in the West, and converting Russian accounts to international standards can turn a profit into a loss.
Figures are not adjusted for inflation or the depreciation of the rouble, but the following data may be helpful.
